blends.name: Temple of the Hoothulhu
blends.desc:
Only the greatest Hootians will enjoy the benefits of this Temple:
- One can be placed per City
- Looks very sick and your residents will have a place to pray to their lord
- Has 500 p/d Stake Value to earn HOOT in our WAX DAO pool. (Highest of all)
- Adds a X amount of Population that DOES NOT require services like Electricity or Water
- Adds a X amount of City Attraction Points to your city
* These amounts are significant BUT will be determined when the game is close to releasing. Also these amounts will be balanced over time so it will have different values over time.
